blurb: Appalachian Outfitters offers canoe, kayak, and tubing trips on the scenic rivers of North Georgia. Trips are suitable for those seeking a scenic float or a ride through rapids. The business operates on varying schedules through spring, summer, and fall. They provide a short tubing float on the Chestatee River, as well as options for canoe and kayak river adventures.
